Akshan|mid.identity: Physical damage marksman-assassin in mid. Three hits on a champion trigger bonus damage and a shield (passive Dirty Fighting), and his attacks fire twice. Avengerang (Q) throws a returning boomerang, Going Rogue (W) camouflages him and speeds him up (and marks enemies who kill his allies: taking them down revives those allies), Heroic Swing (E) swings him around a wall while shooting, and Comeuppance (R) channels bullets that execute.
Akshan|mid.playstyle: Roaming and skirmishing mid, with a unique mechanic that revives allies. Akshan is good at punishing immobile mages and winning messy fights.
Akshan|mid.early_game: Poke with Q and your passive (three hits). Keep E (the swing around a wall) to escape or stick to a target. Roam with W (camouflage) when your wave is pushed.
Akshan|mid.level_1: Orders vary: E → Q → Q or Q → E → Q. Avengerang (Q) pokes and farms; Heroic Swing (E) is for trading and escaping.
Akshan|mid.level_2: Whichever of Q and E you're missing. Q + passive (three hits) is your basic trade.
Akshan|mid.level_3: Second point in Q; Going Rogue (W) comes at level 4. Q is maxed first.
Akshan|mid.level_6: Comeuppance: channels, then fires bullets that execute based on missing health. Use it to finish a fleeing target or secure a kill from range.
power_spikes: Mid game: roams and ally revives.
Akshan|mid.lane_plan: Poke with Q and your passive, keep E to escape. Push your wave before roaming camouflaged with W. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes your roams more profitable. Avoid fights against champions who stick to you (Yasuo, Irelia).
Akshan|mid.trading: Short trade: Q → attacks (passive). Long trade: E around a wall → attacks → Q. Engage when your opponent no longer has their CC; give up on it against champions who stick to you or block your shots (Yasuo's Wind Wall).
threats: Yasuo and his Wind Wall: your hardest matchup.
Vladimir and Diana, who beat you in short fights.
mistakes: Casting E with no wall to swing around.
Channeling your ultimate in range of a CC ability.
Forgetting to kill the marked champion to revive your ally.

matchup_notes.Ahri: Dodge her Charm with E and poke her with Q.
matchup_notes.Viktor: Poke him and stay mobile to dodge his laser.
matchup_notes.Zed: Keep E to dodge his ultimate.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: His Wind Wall blocks your shots: don't trade with him while it's up.
matchup_notes.Vladimir: He heals and beats you in long fights: poke briefly and back off.

Akshan|mid.mid_game: Roams with W, skirmishes and ally revives. Akshan turns messy fights around.
Akshan|mid.late_game: Hit from range, use E to reposition and R to finish low targets. Kill marked champions to revive your allies.
Akshan|mid.ahead: Roam, take objectives and hunt the carries.
Akshan|mid.behind: Farm and look for picks with your ultimate.
Akshan|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to win messy skirmishes and execute low targets with your ultimate.
Akshan|mid.final_tip: In fights, kill the champion marked by W first: it revives your ally.
